page.layout: One page of text in one column; left margin holds only a handwritten annotation, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: cōcertatio ex Iuris scripti; ac non scripti comparatione na-scatur. quanquam ex Pande-ctarum iure nihil iam pro-pter bonorum publicatione ea res dubitationis habeat. L. si quis,9. &L. quia latronib. D. de testament. Eiusdem modi quæstio illa fuit nobi-lis, de qua Principes civitatis Scævolam, Manilium & Brutum diffenfisse, Cic. lib. De fi-nib. 2 testatur: an partus ancil-læ in fructu habendus sit. A similibus enim, aut paribus potius, argumentatio sume-batur, hoc modo: Lex est, Fructum omnem qui percipi ex animalibus potest, fructua-rius

page.notes: Marginal annotation at left (cursive "aliud" and a symbol with "13.") appears handwritten, so it is not transcribed. Running head at top is too faint to read; the words of the title are illegible. Some long-s and ligature forms were normalised (e.g. "Scęuolam" kept with ę, "diffenfisse" read as "dissensisse" in the printed "dissensisse"); the word "fi-nib." and "Pande-ctarum" keep printed line-end hyphens. Reading of "Ctarum" and "Scævolam" is uncertain at this scan resolution.
